# Cntxt Labs

> Cntxt Labs (also written cntxt, pronounced "context") is a small software company in New Zealand, founded by Cristian Rus and operating since 2017. It designs and builds apps for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, for the web and for Android. More than 1.75 million people around the world have downloaded its apps.

- Contact: info@cntxtlabs.co. It is the only address the company uses, for support, press and partnerships alike.
- Based in New Zealand. NZBN 9429053827906.
- Founder: Cristian Rus, https://cristianrus.me
- Name it "Cntxt Labs" in full, or "cntxt" for short. Please link to https://cntxtlabs.co when quoting this file.
- Every page on the site is described here. The complete text, including privacy and common questions, is in [llms-full.txt](https://cntxtlabs.co/llms-full.txt).

## Products

- [Left](https://cntxtlabs.co/left): Shows the time you have left (the year, the week, the day and a life) as symbols that dim as they pass, then helps you act on it with habits, streaks, goals, countdowns and a planner for the day. Used by more than 1.5 million people. iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. Website: https://getleft.app
- [SafePlate](https://cntxtlabs.co/safeplate): Replaces the paper food safety diary in New Zealand kitchens. Records are made on a phone as the work happens and kept for four years. Web, Android, iPhone. Website: https://safeplate.nz
- [KiwiCamping](https://cntxtlabs.co/kiwicamping): A camping map and road-trip planner for New Zealand: more than 6,500 places stored on your phone, filters, place details, and a trip planner with distance and driving time for every leg, dates, notes and forecasts per stop. iPhone, iPad. Website: https://campingapp.nz
- [AussieCamps](https://cntxtlabs.co/aussiecamps): A camping map and road-trip planner for Australia: more than 74,000 places stored on your phone, filters, place details, and a trip planner with distance and driving time for every leg, dates, notes and forecasts per stop. iPhone, iPad. Website: https://aussiecamps.app
- [txtpod](https://cntxtlabs.co/txtpod): Reads the articles, links and PDFs you save out loud, word for word, in natural voices, and delivers them to your own private podcast feed. Also makes episodes on topics you choose and daily news briefs. iPhone, iPad and the web. Website: https://txtpod.app
- [NoSnus](https://cntxtlabs.co/nosnus): A step-down plan to get off nicotine pouches and snus that limits both pouches and milligrams per day, with a projected pouch-free date, one-tap logging and help with cravings. No account. iPhone, iPad.
- [ftnss](https://cntxtlabs.co/ftnss): A private AI coach that reads your Apple Health data and turns it into training, nutrition and recovery advice. iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. Website: https://ftnss.app
- [Bites](https://cntxtlabs.co/bites): Logs a meal from one sentence; Apple Intelligence works out the calories and macros. iPhone, iPad.
- [NotSoBusy](https://cntxtlabs.co/notsobusy): Shows when you are busy without sharing your calendar: a picture of busy and free time with no event details. iPhone, iPad.
